title: Classic Margherita Pizza
subtitle: San Marzano tomatoes, mozzarella, basil

steps.step: Preheat oven to its highest setting (250°C/480°F or higher) with a pizza stone or upturned tray inside.
Crush the tomatoes by hand and season with salt; this is your sauce, no cooking needed.
Stretch the dough into a 12-inch round on a floured surface or peel.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce, leaving a border for the crust.
Tear the mozzarella into pieces and scatter over the sauce, drizzle with olive oil.
Slide onto the hot stone and bake 8-10 minutes until the crust is charred in spots.
Top with fresh basil leaves right out of the oven and serve immediately.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
subtitle: Eggs, pecorino, guanciale, black pepper

steps.step: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
While pasta cooks, cut guanciale into small strips and render in a cold pan over medium heat until crisp.
Whisk eggs, grated pecorino, and black pepper together in a bowl.
Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain pasta and add to the pan with guanciale off the heat.
Quickly stir in the egg mixture, adding splashes of pasta water until glossy and creamy.
Serve immediately with extra pecorino and black pepper.

title: Creamy Mushroom Risotto
subtitle: Arborio rice, parmesan, white wine

steps.step: Sauté mushrooms in a splash of oil until golden, season, and set aside.
In the same pan, melt half the butter and cook onion until soft.
Add rice and toast for 1-2 minutes, stirring, until edges turn translucent.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, waiting until absorbed before adding more, about 18-20 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, remaining butter, and parmesan; season to taste and rest 2 minutes before serving.

title: Lasagna alla Bolognese
subtitle: Layered pasta with meat ragù and béchamel

steps.step: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery until soft, then brown the ground beef.
Add crushed tomatoes, season, and simmer the ragù uncovered for 45-60 minutes.
For the béchamel, melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in warm milk until thickened; season with nutmeg and salt.
Cook lasagna sheets if not oven-ready, per package directions.
Layer sauce, pasta sheets, and béchamel in a baking dish, repeating to fill, finishing with béchamel and parmesan on top.
Bake at 190°C/375°F for 30-35 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Caprese Salad
subtitle: Tomato, mozzarella, basil, balsamic glaze

steps.step: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into rounds of similar thickness.
Arrange alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella on a plate, tucking basil leaves between.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and freshly cracked pepper, and serve immediately.

title: Tiramisu
subtitle: Coffee-soaked ladyfingers, mascarpone cream

steps.step: Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale, then fold in mascarpone until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg whites to stiff peaks and gently fold into the mascarpone mixture.
Dip each ladyfinger briefly in cooled espresso and arrange a layer in a dish.
Spread half the mascarpone cream over the biscuits, then repeat with another biscuit layer and cream.
Dust generously with cocoa powder and refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.

title: Chicken Tacos al Pastor
subtitle: Marinated chicken, pineapple, cilantro

steps.step: Marinate chicken thighs in achiote paste, lime juice, and a splash of oil for at least 30 minutes.
Sear chicken in a hot skillet until charred and cooked through, then dice.
Quickly char pineapple pieces in the same pan for extra caramelization.
Warm tortillas over a flame or dry skillet until pliable.
Fill tortillas with chicken, pineapple, onion, and cilantro.
Serve with lime wedges to squeeze over the top.

title: Beef Barbacoa
subtitle: Slow-cooked, chipotle-spiced shredded beef

steps.step: Blend chipotles, garlic, cumin, and lime juice with a little broth into a smooth paste.
Sear the beef on all sides in a hot pot until browned.
Pour the chipotle paste and remaining broth over the beef, add bay leaves.
Cover and cook low and slow (slow cooker on low for 8 hours, or oven at 150°C/300°F for 4 hours) until fork-tender.
Shred the beef with two forks directly in the cooking liquid to soak up flavor.
Serve in tacos, bowls, or over rice.

title: Guacamole
subtitle: Avocado, lime, jalapeño, cilantro

steps.step: Halve and pit the avocados, then scoop flesh into a bowl.
Mash to your preferred texture, chunky or smooth, with a fork.
Stir in lime juice, onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and salt.
Taste and adjust salt and lime, then serve immediately with tortilla chips.

title: Chiles Rellenos
subtitle: Poblano peppers stuffed with cheese, fried in egg batter

steps.step: Char peppers over an open flame or under a broiler until blackened all over, then steam in a covered bowl 10 minutes and peel.
Slit each pepper lengthwise and remove seeds, keeping the stem intact, then stuff with cheese.
Whisk egg whites to stiff peaks, then fold in yolks and flour to make a light batter.
Dredge stuffed peppers in a little flour, then dip fully in the egg batter.
Fry in hot oil, turning gently, until golden on all sides, then drain on paper towels.
Serve warm, topped with warmed tomato sauce.

title: Mexican Street Corn (Elote)
subtitle: Grilled corn with crema, cotija, chili

steps.step: Grill or char corn over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until charred in spots, about 10-12 minutes.
Brush each ear with mayonnaise while still warm.
Sprinkle generously with cotija cheese and chili powder.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges to squeeze over.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
subtitle: Creamy tomato curry with charred chicken

steps.step: Marinate chicken in yogurt, half the ginger-garlic paste, chili powder, and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Sear marinated chicken in a hot pan until charred at the edges; set aside.
In the same pan, melt butter and cook remaining ginger-garlic paste until fragrant.
Add tomato purée and garam masala, simmer 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in cream and return chicken to the pan, simmering until cooked through.
Finish with a knob of butter and serve with rice or naan.

title: Chana Masala
subtitle: Spiced chickpea curry

steps.step: Heat oil and sizzle cumin seeds until fragrant.
Add onion and cook until golden, then stir in ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, and coriander powder; cook until tomatoes break down.
Add chickpeas and enough water to just cover, simmer 15-20 minutes.
Mash a few chickpeas to thicken the sauce, stir in garam masala.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with rice or roti.

title: Vegetable Biryani
subtitle: Fragrant layered rice with spiced vegetables

steps.step: Soak rice for 30 minutes, then parboil with whole spices until 70% cooked; drain.
Sauté vegetables with ginger-garlic paste and biryani spice blend until just tender.
Stir yogurt, half the fried onions, and herbs into the vegetables to make the base layer.
Layer par-cooked rice over the vegetable mixture in a heavy pot.
Top with remaining fried onions, herbs, and a splash of saffron-infused milk.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20-25 minutes, then rest 5 minutes before fluffing and serving.

title: Palak Paneer
subtitle: Paneer cubes in a creamy spinach curry

steps.step: Blanch spinach in boiling water for 2 minutes, then blend into a smooth purée.
Lightly pan-fry paneer cubes until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion until golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato, cook until soft.
Stir in the spinach purée and garam masala, simmer 5-8 minutes.
Add paneer and cream, simmer 2-3 minutes more.
Serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Masala Dosa
subtitle: Fermented rice-lentil crepe with spiced potato filling

steps.step: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in hot oil until they pop.
Add onion and cook until soft, then stir in turmeric.
Add boiled potatoes, mash lightly, and season with salt; this is the filling.
Heat a flat griddle and spread a ladle of dosa batter into a thin circle.
Drizzle oil around the edges and cook until crisp and golden underneath.
Spoon potato filling onto one side, fold the dosa over, and serve hot with chutney and sambar.

title: Kung Pao Chicken
subtitle: Stir-fried chicken, peanuts, chili

steps.step: Marinate diced chicken in a spoon of soy sauce and a little cornstarch for 15 minutes.
Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until just cooked, then remove.
Fry dried chilies and garlic briefly in the same wok until fragrant, careful not to burn.
Return chicken to the wok, add remaining soy sauce and rice vinegar, toss to coat.
Stir in peanuts and spring onion, tossing 1 more minute.
Serve immediately over steamed rice.

title: Vegetable Fried Rice
subtitle: Wok-fried rice with egg and vegetables

steps.step: Heat oil in a wok and scramble the eggs until just set; remove and set aside.
Add a little more oil, sauté garlic and vegetables until crisp-tender.
Add the cold rice, breaking up clumps, and stir-fry until heated through.
Push rice to the sides, pour soy sauce into the center, then toss everything together.
Fold in the scrambled egg and spring onion, drizzle with sesame oil, and serve hot.

title: Mapo Tofu
subtitle: Silken tofu in spicy Sichuan sauce

steps.step: Brown the ground pork in hot oil until crispy at the edges.
Add garlic, ginger, and doubanjiang, stir-fry until fragrant and oil turns red.
Pour in a cup of stock or water and bring to a simmer.
Gently slide in the tofu cubes and simmer 5 minutes without stirring hard, to keep tofu intact.
Thicken with a cornstarch slurry, then sprinkle with ground Sichuan peppercorn and spring onion.
Serve hot over steamed rice.

title: Hot and Sour Soup
subtitle: Tangy, spicy soup with tofu and mushrooms

steps.step: Bring stock to a simmer and add tofu and mushrooms, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in vinegar, soy sauce, and white pepper; taste and adjust for tang and heat.
Thicken the soup by stirring in the cornstarch slurry until glossy.
Slowly drizzle in beaten egg while stirring gently to form ribbons.
Ladle into bowls and top with sesame oil and spring onion.

title: Char Siu Pork
subtitle: Cantonese barbecue-glazed pork

steps.step: Whisk hoisin, soy sauce, half the honey, five spice, and garlic into a marinade.
Marinate pork strips at least 4 hours or overnight in the fridge.
Roast on a rack at 190°C/375°F for 25 minutes, turning and basting halfway.
Brush with remaining honey and broil 2-3 minutes until caramelized and slightly charred.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice and serve with steamed rice.

title: Green Curry Chicken
subtitle: Coconut curry with Thai basil

steps.step: Fry curry paste in a spoon of coconut cream until fragrant and oil separates.
Add chicken and stir to coat in the paste, cooking until color changes.
Pour in remaining coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer.
Add eggplant, fish sauce, and palm sugar; simmer 10-12 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Stir in Thai basil leaves just before serving.
Serve with steamed jasmine rice.

title: Pad Thai
subtitle: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, tamarind

steps.step: Soak rice noodles in warm water until pliable but still firm, then drain.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar into a sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp in hot oil until pink, push to one side, then scramble the eggs in the same pan.
Add drained noodles and sauce, toss constantly until noodles soften and absorb the sauce.
Fold in bean sprouts and toss 1 more minute.
Plate and top with crushed peanuts, lime wedges, and extra bean sprouts.

title: Tom Yum Goong
subtitle: Hot and sour shrimp soup with lemongrass

steps.step: Simmer shrimp shells in water 10 minutes to make a quick stock, then strain.
Return stock to the pot and add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, and galangal; simmer 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and mushrooms, cook until shrimp turns pink.
Remove from heat and stir in fish sauce, lime juice, and crushed chilies.
Taste and balance sour, salty, and spicy before serving hot.

title: Thai Basil Beef Stir-Fry (Pad Krapow)
subtitle: Minced beef, holy basil, chili, garlic

steps.step: Pound garlic and chilies together into a rough paste using a mortar or knife.
Fry the garlic-chili paste in hot oil until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Add ground beef and stir-fry over high heat until browned and cooked through.
Season with fish sauce and soy sauce, tossing to coat.
Remove from heat and fold in basil leaves until just wilted.
Serve over steamed rice topped with a crispy fried egg.

title: Chicken Katsu Curry
subtitle: Crispy breaded chicken, Japanese curry sauce

steps.step: Simmer onion, carrot, and potato in water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Break curry roux into the pot and stir until dissolved into a thick sauce; keep warm.
Dredge chicken in flour, then egg, then panko, pressing to coat evenly.
Shallow-fry breaded chicken until golden and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice the chicken katsu into strips.
Serve over steamed rice, ladled generously with curry sauce.

title: Miso Ramen
subtitle: Rich miso broth, noodles, soft egg

steps.step: Bring stock to a simmer and whisk in miso paste until dissolved.
Cook ramen noodles separately according to package directions, then drain.
Divide noodles between two bowls and ladle the hot miso broth over.
Top each bowl with a halved soft-boiled egg, corn, and spring onion.
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and serve immediately.

title: Teriyaki Salmon
subtitle: Pan-glazed salmon in sweet soy sauce

steps.step: Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sake, and sugar together for the teriyaki sauce.
Pan-sear salmon skin-side down in a hot pan until crisp, then flip.
Pour the sauce into the pan and let it bubble, spooning it over the salmon as it thickens.
Cook until salmon is just cooked through and the glaze coats it thickly, about 2-3 minutes.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with steamed rice.

title: Vegetable Tempura
subtitle: Light, crispy battered vegetables

steps.step: Slice vegetables into thin, even pieces so they cook quickly.
Whisk egg into ice-cold water, then gently fold in flour and cornstarch; leave the batter lumpy.
Heat oil to 180°C/350°F.
Dip vegetable pieces in batter and fry a few at a time until light golden and crisp, about 2 minutes.
Drain on a rack and serve immediately with dipping sauce or salt.

title: Chicken Shawarma
subtitle: Spiced roasted chicken, garlic sauce, pita

steps.step: Mix yogurt, half the garlic, spices, and lemon juice into a marinade.
Coat chicken thighs thoroughly and marinate at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Roast at 220°C/425°F or grill until charred at the edges and cooked through, about 25-30 minutes.
Rest, then slice the chicken thinly.
Whisk remaining garlic into extra yogurt to make a quick garlic sauce.
Serve sliced chicken in warm pita with garlic sauce and pickled vegetables.

title: Falafel
subtitle: Crispy chickpea fritters

steps.step: Drain soaked (uncooked) chickpeas and pulse in a food processor with onion, garlic, and parsley until finely ground but not pasty.
Mix in cumin, coriander, salt, and baking powder.
Chill the mixture 30 minutes so it holds together.
Shape into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until deeply golden and crisp, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain and serve in pita with tahini sauce and salad.

title: Greek Moussaka
subtitle: Layered eggplant, spiced meat, béchamel

steps.step: Salt sliced eggplant and let sit 20 minutes to draw out moisture, then pat dry and brush with oil, roast until soft.
Brown the meat with onion, then add crushed tomatoes and cinnamon, simmer 20 minutes.
Make béchamel by whisking flour into melted butter, then gradually adding milk until thick; stir in cheese.
Layer roasted eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, repeating.
Top with béchamel, spreading evenly to the edges.
Bake at 190°C/375°F for 35-40 minutes until golden on top; rest 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Hummus
subtitle: Creamy chickpea and tahini dip

steps.step: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and cumin in a food processor until smooth.
With the motor running, drizzle in olive oil and a splash of cold water until light and creamy.
Taste and adjust salt, lemon, or water for consistency.
Spread onto a plate, drizzle with more olive oil, and serve with pita or vegetables.

title: Greek Salad
subtitle: Tomato, cucumber, olives, feta

steps.step: Combine tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Toss with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon if you like, and season with salt.
Place the block of feta on top rather than crumbling it, in the traditional style.
Sprinkle with dried oregano and a final drizzle of olive oil before serving.

title: Classic Cheeseburger
subtitle: Juicy beef patty, cheddar, all the fixings

steps.step: Divide beef into 4 portions and shape into patties slightly wider than the buns; season both sides generously.
Heat a skillet or grill to high heat.
Cook patties 3-4 minutes per side for medium, adding cheese in the last minute to melt.
Toast the buns cut-side down until lightly golden.
Build the burger with lettuce, patty, tomato, and onion.
Serve immediately with your favorite condiments.

title: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
subtitle: Crispy, spiced Southern-style fried chicken

steps.step: Marinate chicken in buttermilk with a pinch of salt for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Mix flour with paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a wide dish.
Remove chicken from buttermilk, letting excess drip off, then dredge thoroughly in the seasoned flour.
Heat oil to 170°C/340°F and fry chicken in batches, turning occasionally, until deep golden, about 12-15 minutes.
Check internal temperature reaches 74°C/165°F, then drain on a rack.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Mac and Cheese
subtitle: Baked pasta in a rich cheese sauce

steps.step: Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, and cook 1 minute to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth, simmer until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in most of the cheese until melted.
Fold in the macaroni, transfer to a baking dish, top with remaining cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake at 190°C/375°F for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden on top.

title: BBQ Pulled Pork
subtitle: Slow-cooked pork shoulder in tangy barbecue sauce

steps.step: Rub pork shoulder generously with brown sugar, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Slow-cook (150°C/300°F in the oven, or low in a slow cooker) for 5-6 hours until the meat pulls apart easily.
Rest the pork, then shred with two forks, discarding excess fat.
Toss shredded pork with barbecue sauce and a splash of vinegar for brightness.
Pile onto toasted buns and serve with coleslaw.

title: New York Cheesecake
subtitle: Dense, creamy baked cheesecake

steps.step: Mix crushed biscuits with melted butter and press firmly into a springform pan; chill.
Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth and lump-free.
Add eggs one at a time, beating gently after each addition — do not overmix.
Stir in sour cream and vanilla, then pour the batter over the chilled crust.
Bake at 160°C/325°F using a water bath for about 55-65 minutes, until the center is just set with a slight jiggle.
Cool completely, then refrigerate at least 4 hours before slicing.

title: Coq au Vin
subtitle: Chicken braised in red wine with mushrooms

steps.step: Brown bacon lardons in a heavy pot, then remove and brown chicken pieces in the fat.
Add pearl onions and mushrooms, cook until lightly browned.
Return chicken and bacon to the pot, sprinkle with flour, and stir to coat.
Pour in red wine, add garlic and thyme, bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise gently for 45-60 minutes until chicken is tender.
Finish by stirring in a knob of butter for a glossy sauce, then serve.

title: French Onion Soup
subtitle: Caramelized onions, beef broth, melted gruyère

steps.step: Melt butter in a heavy pot and cook onions low and slow, stirring often, for 40-45 minutes until deep golden and caramelized.
Deglaze with white wine, scraping up browned bits.
Add beef stock, bring to a simmer, and cook 20 minutes to develop flavor.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top each with a slice of toasted baguette and a generous pile of gruyère.
Broil until the cheese is melted and bubbling with brown spots.
Serve immediately, careful — the bowls will be hot.

title: Ratatouille
subtitle: Stewed Provençal vegetables

steps.step: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add eggplant and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in zucchini and bell peppers, cook 5 more minutes.
Add tomatoes and herbes de Provence, season with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer gently for 30-35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are tender and stew-like.
Serve warm or at room temperature, with crusty bread.

title: Crème Brûlée
subtitle: Silky custard with a crackling caramel top

steps.step: Heat cream with vanilla until just steaming, then remove from heat.
Whisk egg yolks with sugar until pale, then slowly whisk in the warm cream.
Strain the mixture and divide among ramekins.
Bake in a water bath at 150°C/300°F for about 35-40 minutes until just set with a slight wobble.
Chill at least 2 hours.
Sprinkle a thin layer of sugar on top and caramelize with a kitchen torch (or under a broiler) just before serving.

title: Beef Tehari
subtitle: Fragrant mustard-oil rice with tender beef

steps.step: Marinate beef in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and salt for 30 minutes.
Heat mustard oil and fry onions until deep golden; remove half for garnish.
Add whole spices and marinated beef, cook until browned.
Add potatoes and enough water to cover, simmer until beef is tender, about 40 minutes.
Add soaked rice and enough hot water to cook it through, cover, and cook on low heat until rice is done.
Fluff gently and garnish with reserved fried onions before serving.

title: Bhuna Khichuri
subtitle: Rice and lentils cooked with ghee and spices

steps.step: Dry-roast the moong dal in a pan until lightly fragrant, then rinse with the rice.
Heat ghee and fry onion, bay leaf, and cumin seeds until onion softens.
Add rice and dal, stir to coat in the ghee and turmeric.
Pour in hot water (about double the volume of rice and dal), season with salt.
Simmer covered until rice and dal are soft and the khichuri is thick, stirring occasionally, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve hot with a drizzle of extra ghee, alongside fried eggplant or an egg.

title: Shingara (Bengali Samosa)
subtitle: Crisp pastry filled with spiced potato and peanuts

steps.step: Rub ghee into flour with a pinch of salt, then knead with water into a firm dough; rest 20 minutes.
Sauté cumin seeds, cauliflower, and peanuts, then fold in cubed potato and mash lightly, season well.
Divide dough into balls, roll into ovals, and cut in half to make two cones per piece.
Fold each half into a cone, fill with the potato mixture, and seal the edges with a little water.
Deep-fry the samosas on medium heat, turning, until golden and crisp, about 8-10 minutes.
Drain and serve hot with tamarind chutney.

title: Fuchka (Bengali Pani Puri)
subtitle: Crisp shells filled with tangy tamarind water and chickpeas

steps.step: Blend tamarind pulp, mint, green chili, chaat masala, and cold water into a tangy, spiced water; strain and chill.
Mix boiled chickpeas and diced potato with a pinch of chaat masala for the filling.
Tap a hole in the top of each puri shell with your thumb.
Fill each shell with the potato-chickpea mixture.
Just before eating, dip or fill each puri with the tamarind water and eat immediately so they stay crisp.

title: Bibimbap
subtitle: Mixed rice bowl with vegetables and gochujang

steps.step: Season beef with soy sauce, garlic, and a little sesame oil, then stir-fry until browned.
Sauté carrot briefly until just tender, keeping each vegetable separate.
Season blanched spinach and bean sprouts each with a little salt and sesame oil.
Divide rice among bowls and arrange beef and vegetables in sections on top.
Top each bowl with a fried egg, sunny-side up.
Serve with a spoonful of gochujang on the side to mix in before eating.

title: Korean Fried Chicken
subtitle: Double-fried chicken in a sticky gochujang glaze

steps.step: Toss chicken wings in cornstarch until evenly coated.
Fry at 160°C/320°F for 8 minutes, remove and rest 5 minutes.
Fry a second time at 190°C/375°F for 3-4 minutes until deeply crisp.
Whisk gochujang, honey, soy sauce, and garlic in a pan and warm until glossy.
Toss the double-fried wings in the glaze until fully coated.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately.

title: Kimchi Jjigae
subtitle: Spicy fermented kimchi and pork stew

steps.step: Stir-fry pork belly in a pot until it renders some fat and browns lightly.
Add kimchi and its juice, cook 5 minutes to deepen the flavor.
Pour in water or stock to cover, add gochugaru and garlic, and simmer 15 minutes.
Add tofu and simmer 5 more minutes without stirring too hard.
Top with spring onion and serve bubbling hot with rice.

title: Beef Pho
subtitle: Fragrant beef noodle soup

steps.step: Blanch beef bones in boiling water 5 minutes to remove impurities, then rinse.
Simmer bones with charred ginger and onion for 2-3 hours, skimming regularly.
Toast star anise and cinnamon in a dry pan, then add to the simmering broth for the last 30 minutes.
Season broth with fish sauce and salt, then strain.
Soak rice noodles until soft, blanch briefly, and divide among bowls.
Top noodles with raw sliced beef, ladle boiling broth over to cook it, and serve with herbs, lime, and bean sprouts.

title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls (Gỏi Cuốn)
subtitle: Fresh rice paper rolls with shrimp and herbs

steps.step: Dip a rice paper wrapper briefly in warm water until just pliable.
Lay it flat and place lettuce, vermicelli, herbs, and two shrimp halves near the bottom edge.
Fold the sides in and roll tightly from the bottom, like a burrito.
Repeat with remaining wrappers and filling.
Serve fresh with peanut sauce for dipping.

title: Bún Chả
subtitle: Grilled pork with rice noodles and dipping sauce

steps.step: Marinate pork in a spoon each of fish sauce, sugar, and minced garlic for 20 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear pork slices until charred and cooked through.
Whisk remaining fish sauce, sugar, lime juice, and garlic with warm water into a dipping sauce (nuoc cham).
Cook rice vermicelli according to package directions, then rinse and drain.
Serve grilled pork alongside vermicelli, lettuce, and herbs, with the dipping sauce for combining at the table.

title: Shakshuka
subtitle: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce

steps.step: Sauté onion and bell pepper until soft, then add garlic, cumin, and paprika.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season, and simmer 15 minutes until thickened.
Make small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until egg whites are set but yolks remain runny, about 6-8 minutes.
Garnish with fresh herbs and serve straight from the pan with crusty bread.

title: Overnight Oats
subtitle: No-cook oats soaked with fruit and yogurt

steps.step: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, honey, and chia seeds in a jar.
Stir well to make sure the oats are fully submerged.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, or at least 4 hours.
Top with fresh berries before eating, cold or gently warmed.

title: Belgian Waffles
subtitle: Crisp, deep-pocketed waffles

steps.step: Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder together in a bowl.
In another bowl, whisk egg yolks, milk, and melted butter, then stir into the dry ingredients.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks and gently fold into the batter.
Preheat and grease a waffle iron, then pour in batter per the iron's instructions.
Cook until golden and crisp, about 4-5 minutes, and serve immediately with syrup and fruit.

title: Huevos Rancheros
subtitle: Fried eggs over tortillas with salsa and beans

steps.step: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet until pliable, then spread with refried beans.
Fry eggs sunny-side up in a lightly oiled pan.
Warm the salsa in a small pan.
Place a fried egg on each bean-topped tortilla and spoon salsa over.
Top with crumbled queso fresco and sliced avocado, and serve immediately.

title: Classic French Toast
subtitle: Custard-soaked bread, pan-fried golden

steps.step: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla together in a wide, shallow dish.
Soak each bread slice for about 20 seconds per side, letting excess drip off.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Fry soaked bread until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with maple syrup, fresh fruit, or powdered sugar.

title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
subtitle: Chewy centers, crisp edges

steps.step: Cream butter with both sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time.
Whisk flour, baking soda, and a pinch of salt, then fold into the wet mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop onto a lined baking sheet and bake at 180°C/350°F for 10-12 minutes until edges are golden.
Cool on the tray a few minutes before transferring to a rack.

title: Banana Bread
subtitle: Moist, spiced loaf with ripe bananas

steps.step: Mix mashed bananas with melted butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs, then whisk in baking soda, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Fold in flour just until combined, don't overmix.
Pour into a greased loaf pan.
Bake at 175°C/350°F for 55-60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the pan 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool fully before slicing.

title: Baklava
subtitle: Layered phyllo pastry with nuts and honey syrup

steps.step: Mix chopped nuts with cinnamon.
Layer about 8 sheets of phyllo in a buttered baking dish, brushing each sheet with melted butter.
Spread half the nut mixture over the phyllo, add more buttered phyllo sheets, then the rest of the nuts, then a final stack of buttered phyllo on top.
Cut into diamond shapes before baking.
Bake at 160°C/325°F for 45-50 minutes until golden and crisp.
Simmer sugar, honey, and lemon juice into a syrup, then pour evenly over the hot baklava as soon as it comes out of the oven; let it soak in fully before serving.

title: Churros with Chocolate Sauce
subtitle: Fried dough sticks dusted in cinnamon sugar

steps.step: Bring water and butter to a boil, then remove from heat and beat in flour until a smooth dough forms.
Beat in eggs one at a time until the dough is glossy and stretchy.
Pipe strips of dough directly into hot oil using a star-tipped piping bag, frying until golden.
Drain and toss immediately in cinnamon sugar while warm.
Melt chocolate with a splash of cream for a dipping sauce.
Serve churros warm alongside the chocolate sauce.

title: Mango Sticky Rice
subtitle: Sweet coconut sticky rice with fresh mango

steps.step: Steam soaked glutinous rice over simmering water for 20-25 minutes until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt until dissolved, reserving a little for topping.
Stir most of the sweetened coconut milk into the hot rice and let it absorb, about 10 minutes.
Plate the sticky rice alongside sliced mango.
Drizzle with the reserved coconut milk and serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Apple Pie
subtitle: Flaky crust, cinnamon-spiced apple filling

steps.step: Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon, and flour.
Line a pie dish with one disc of dough, trimming the excess.
Fill with the apple mixture and dot with butter.
Cover with the second disc of dough, crimp the edges to seal, and cut a few vents on top.
Bake at 200°C/400°F for 20 minutes, then reduce to 180°C/350°F and bake 35-40 minutes more until golden and bubbling.
Cool at least 2 hours before slicing so the filling sets.

title: Classic Minestrone
subtitle: Hearty Italian vegetable and bean soup

steps.step: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and stock, along with parmesan rind if using.
Simmer 15 minutes to let the vegetables soften further.
Add pasta and beans, cook until pasta is tender, about 10 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with grated parmesan and crusty bread.

title: Chicken Noodle Soup
subtitle: Comforting broth with chicken and vegetables

steps.step: Simmer chicken in stock with onion, carrot, celery, and thyme until cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Remove chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.
Bring the broth back to a simmer and add egg noodles.
Cook until noodles are tender, about 8-10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Caesar Salad
subtitle: Crisp romaine, parmesan, garlicky dressing, croutons

steps.step: Toss bread cubes with olive oil and garlic, then bake or pan-toast until golden and crisp for croutons.
Whisk mayonnaise, minced anchovy, minced garlic, lemon juice, and parmesan into a dressing.
Toss romaine lettuce with the dressing until evenly coated.
Top with croutons and extra shaved parmesan.
Serve immediately while croutons are still crisp.

title: Roasted Tomato Soup
subtitle: Rich, slow-roasted tomato soup with basil

steps.step: Roast tomatoes, onion, and garlic with olive oil at 200°C/400°F for 30-35 minutes until caramelized.
Squeeze roasted garlic from its skin and blend everything with the stock until smooth.
Return to a pot, stir in cream, and warm gently without boiling.
Season to taste and stir in torn basil leaves just before serving.
Serve with crusty bread or a grilled cheese sandwich.
